name: roastbyai
description: Roast by AI for coding agents: a website critic in your coding loop. Roast a site that is not live yet, fix the findings, re-roast until the score clears your target. Works with Claude Code, Cursor and Codex.

plugins.name: roastbyai
plugins.description: Roast a website that is not live yet, fix the findings in your code, re-roast until the score clears your target. Eight categories, scores with deltas, findings with locations.
